purpose: Source-authored predicate contract for custom law profiles that require a real damage-taken event. This records committed damage-taken semantics only; it does not prove final damage ordering, receiver identity, death ordering, kill correlation, rage/warcry correlation, or authorize gameplay mutation.
requiredRuntimeProof: attacker and receiver side correlation proof

forbiddenSubstitutes: attempted attack counted as damage taken
blocked or zero damage counted as damage taken
damage animation counted as damage taken
damage plan preview counted as damage taken
attacker damage dealt counted without receiver proof
poison or slow status tick counted without damage receiver proof
fortress.damage-taken-slow-poison-packag.notes: Fortress damage-taken slow/poison package requires positive committed damage to the receiving unit stack; status presence or attack animation is not enough.

forbiddenSubstitutes: attempted attack counted as damage taken
blocked or zero damage counted as damage taken
damage animation counted as damage taken
damage plan preview counted as damage taken
kill event counted as damage taken without damage receiver proof
rage or warcry event counted as damage taken
stronghold.damage-kill-rage-package.notes: Stronghold damage/kill/rage package requires positive committed damage to the receiving unit stack plus separate kill/loss and rage/warcry predicates where used.

forbiddenSubstitutes: attempted attack counted as damage taken
blocked or zero damage counted as damage taken
damage animation counted as damage taken
damage plan preview counted as damage taken
slow or poison status presence counted as damage taken
momentum trigger counted without committed damage proof
fortress.damage-taken-or-slow-poison-mom.notes: Fortress damage-taken momentum requires positive committed damage to the receiving unit stack when using the damage branch; slow/poison status logic remains a separate predicate concern.

stronghold.damage-kill-tempo.notes: Stronghold damage/kill tempo requires positive committed damage to the receiving unit stack and separate kill/loss proof for the kill branch.
